scope: scratch-generated mesh sources through ODA File Converter and separate FreeCAD readback; AC1024 HEADER suffix characterization
nativeFreecad: The ODA DWG-to-DXF readbacks separately import in the macOS ARM64 headless FreeCAD development candidate with six ordered unmerged patches. The POLYFACE is a one-face compound with all four expected vertices and area 13; the M-closed mesh has three expected face vertex sets matching ezdxf expansion. The following LINE is retained. This route uses ODA to convert DWG, not libdxfrw.
libdxfrw: The installed candidate reads both generated ODA DWGs with operationSucceeded=true, 162/162 and 163/163 observed frames respectively published and no record parse failures. Strict conversion refuses because HEADER integrity reports the maintenance-55 extra word and 739-byte unclaimed suffix. Allow-partial also refuses at VISUALSTYLE carrier coverage; no libdxfrw DXF was published.

headerEvidence.differentDrawings: Both decoded suffixes are 739 bytes, differ at every byte and have a uniform zero XOR in the least significant bit.
headerEvidence.repeatInput: Three independent ODA conversions of the exact same generated input retain 739-byte suffixes but produce three distinct suffix SHA-256 hashes; every pair differs at every suffix byte, with pairwise least-significant-bit XOR uniform across the suffix. This observation does not prove padding or harmlessness.

limits: The input geometry is locally generated; ODA resaves are independent conversion evidence, not independently authored models.
The patched FreeCAD route is headless and unmerged, and ODA performed the DWG-to-DXF step; no libdxfrw output or complete DWG graph is qualified.
Suffix meaning remains unknown; do not treat random-like or changing bytes as disposable without source-bound specification or independent semantic proof.
